svg.title: The Lean library, phase by phase
svg.desc: Bar chart of Lean source lines per file: Phase0 259, Phase1 1,603, Phase2 4,842, Phase2CMI 1,029, Phase3 2,600, Phase4 1,534 and Phase5 800, totalling 12,667 lines. Phases 3, 4 and 5 are Parts I, II and III of the theory; the rest is framework and infrastructure.

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Tinos, 'Liberation Serif', Times, serif

svg.text: THE LEAN LIBRARY, PHASE BY PHASE
